ns2:section.sectionText: This course will focus on various intellectual debates concerning Brazilian music as a cultural practice, an art form, and a commodity. As such, we will discuss Brazilian music as it relates to nationalism, regionalism, and cosmopolitanism. Students will learn about a range of Brazilian genres, from the samba music of Rio de Janeiro’s carnival parades to the rural laments of the drought-ridden northeast region to contemporary hip hop from São Paulo.
